system.longDesc:
Requirement: Cryokinesis (Master)

Cost: 15 PP

Time: Major action

Target Number: 17

Test: Constitution (Stamina) vs. Force

You project a blast of freezing cold from your outstretched hands, 2 yards wide and 8 yards long. Anyone in the area suffers 2d6 + Willpower penetrating cold damage and a –10 penalty to Speed for a number of rounds equal to half your Willpower, rounded down (minimum of 1). Subjects who succeed on the Constitution (Stamina) test vs. your Force only take 1d6 + Willpower penetrating damage and a –5 penalty to Speed.
